notes: Converted from MAME's src/mame/sega/nl_brdrline.cpp (NETLIST_START(brdrline), CC0-1.0, beta-tester (https://github.com/beta-tester)) at mame0289 by tools/mame_netlist.py. Every change from MAME's file -- the simulation stand-ins undone, the hacks dropped, the corrections from the sheet -- is logged at the top of boards/brdrline-sound.nets.

Compared with both sound board sheets, 834-0055 Rev. A sheets 6 and 7 of 7 (the Borderline manual, doc 7756fbdad1fb, PDF pp. 27-28 -- MAME's 'page 26' and '27' -- with the parts list on pp. 17-20), on 2026-10-20: 42 groups of nets, about 230 pin connections, touching every IC from IC1 to IC38, and about 150 values. All agree but one, IC29 gate 2's two inputs, which MAME has the other way round (the same AND, so the same circuit; corrected above). The sheet letters the MB4391s' IN, CON and OUT pins (1, 2, 15 and 5, 6, 11) as MAME has them, and draws pins 14 and 10 to the 680pF capacitors; the name RO for those, and the supplies on 3, 7, 12 and 16, are MAME's -- no MB4391 supply pin is drawn. MAME's base-and- collector correction holds on all sixteen 2SC458s: as drawn, the 555's DIS could not switch the transistor and nothing would oscillate (a likely cause is the 2SC458's E-C-B leads traced as E-B-C). IC28's RESET is not drawn at all, so nc is the sheet's; a 555 needs it high to run, so the board presumably ties it to +5V with a trace the drawing omits, as it omits every supply pin. All thirteen 555 outputs MAME loads are undrawn, and the spare gates of IC29, IC36 and IC27 are not drawn either.

On the sheet and not in this file: +6V is not a supply but a divider -- R135 and R136, 1K each from +12V, with a 100uF capacitor on each side -- and the supplies come in on edge pins 20 (+12V), 17 (+5V) and 16 (ground), with decoupling MAME leaves out. The triggers enter on edge pins 5-12 (GUN, JEEP, POINT, HIT, ANIMAL, EMAR, WALK, CRY), active low with 1K pull-ups; which latch bit drives which is not on the sheet. The sheet prints LS08, LS74 and LS123 where MAME has plain TTL, no designator on the ANIMAL 555 (MAME's IC1, which sheet 6's reset list supports) or on the 1uF at IC14 pin 5 (MAME's C2), and '555' beside two of IC9's op-amp sections -- a slip; the parts list makes IC9 an LM324. The top of sheet 7 is cut off by the scan (IC34's B/CLR tie, R109's label). The site's 'Star Raker' schematics filed under Borderline (doc 6b1a0aeb2bbe) are Star Raker's logic board, not this one.
